_comment: Named scenario blueprints: each pairs an EXISTING decision module (sepsis|stroke|dka|fabry) with an EXISTING bundled population profile and a human-readable description. No module or profile is invented here; the loader (hipaasynth/scenarios.py) validates every 'module' against hipaasynth.sdk.MODULES and every 'profile' against the bundled profiles at load time. All records generated are synthetic — no PHI.

scenarios.name: tribal_sepsis
scenarios.label: Tribal ICU · Sepsis
scenarios.description: Sepsis decision module + Northern Plains tribal health profile (rural IHS service area, AI/AN-majority). Reflects the elevated sepsis burden documented for Indigenous populations in a low-connectivity, air-gapped deployment context.

scenarios.name: tribal_stroke
scenarios.label: Tribal ICU · Stroke
scenarios.description: Stroke decision module + Northern Plains tribal health profile. The profile's age bands are calibrated for an ICU stroke cohort (mean age 65-68), pairing a rural, majority-AI/AN population with acute-stroke decision support.

scenarios.name: rural_nd_dka
scenarios.label: Rural ND · DKA
scenarios.description: Diabetic ketoacidosis module + Minot, North Dakota profile. Rural upper-Midwest demographics with a high diabetes burden, screening for acute DKA presentations.

scenarios.name: urban_nd_sepsis
scenarios.label: Urban ND · Sepsis
scenarios.description: Sepsis module + Fargo, North Dakota profile — the state's largest urban safety-net setting, contrasting with the rural tribal and small-town ND scenarios.

scenarios.name: karachi_dka
scenarios.label: Karachi · DKA
scenarios.description: DKA module + Karachi, Pakistan profile. A large low/middle-income-country urban population where limited-English-proficiency and low-literacy documentation forms are common, stressing the polymorphic fairness surface.

scenarios.name: lagos_sepsis
scenarios.label: Lagos · Sepsis
scenarios.description: Sepsis module + Lagos, Nigeria profile — a large sub-Saharan-African LMIC cohort, testing sepsis decision consistency across community-health-worker and patient-facing documentation forms.

scenarios.name: fabry_baseline
scenarios.label: US baseline · Fabry
scenarios.description: Fabry disease (rare lysosomal storage disorder) module + US national reference profile. A rare-condition screening baseline against a general US population.

scenarios.name: us_baseline_sepsis
scenarios.label: US baseline · Sepsis
scenarios.description: Sepsis module + US national reference profile (ACS/NHANES). The neutral national baseline for comparison against the region- and country-specific scenarios.
